title: GGP Push to Web Pilot
descriptions: This data was collected as part of the Generations and Gender Programme - Evaluate, Plan, Initiate Project (Grant Agreement No 739511). The pilot consisted of online and face to face survey interviews in order to evaluate the impact of mode and selection effects on data quality in the Generations and Gender Survey. Data was collected in Germany, Croatia and Portugal in 2018.
